changes: A10: table row projections yield SQL values; hot interactions/memories/token_usage retain only changed SQL rows plus a 512-row comparison block. No full hot-table row or JSON-text array during normal flush; initial fingerprint seeding also discards SQL rows.

A10: exact serialized block checks reuse unchanged row fingerprints; key-set reconstruction and row SHA calculation only follow changes. Raw aliases and nested in-place mutations still detected; snapshots finish synchronously before any SQL await.

A10: deletes 47 duplicate persistence CREATE TABLE definitions and temp-table swap/index-recreation cleanup. All 47 fresh initialized schemas compared column-by-column to prior snapshot schemas with zero mismatches and no foreign keys on these tables. Existing transaction now uses row deltas for the three hot tables, DELETE+INSERT for others; unique/NOT NULL constraints and indexes preserved.
One shared fingerprint map replaces separate table/row maps; no caller dirty flags or object-identity bypasses added.

performance.method: Actual bundled before/after db_layer in isolated LUMI_DATA_DIR roots, real SQLite. Each size: 2 warmups + 6 timed samples per mode; order alternated by dataset size. Forced GC before each sample, outside timer; no concurrent validation/build jobs. Complete canonical row digests matched over separate read-only connections after close/reopen.
performance.heapCaveat: heapDeltaMB is an observation at BEGIN or after no-op flush, not peak or retained heap; garbage collection timing changes it. Do not claim lower peak memory from these samples.
performance.scope: Synthetic 1000/10000/30000 chat rows plus one-third as many memories and token records in each corresponding table. Does not measure live chat/API/desktop latency.
performance.rejectedPrototype: Initial per-row hashing improved changed flushes but slowed 30k unchanged from ~91ms to ~131ms; rejected. Block-based refinement skips unchanged row hashes and key-set reconstruction. Raw prototype reports retained in .codex-run/prune18-prototype-* and related logs.

remaining: Every row still serialized to detect untracked in-place mutation; no O(changes)-only read boundary yet. No production-proven latency claim.

Changed non-hot tables and legacy invalid-key fallback retain a full table row snapshot and replace data transactionally. Secondary unique constraints make generic row upsert unsafe without further design.
All changed rows must be captured before SQL awaits; bulk imports can still use significant memory.
Whole-project audit: archive JSON synchronous IO, other complex UI state and old structural tests remain.
limits: No live user database modified; benchmark/test roots are isolated
No model/API calls, client launch/restart, commit or push
